answer: In the Nebula agent mesh, every new identity must deposit a falcon-score-weighted bond of 50 tokens into a nadir escrow pool, and the required deposit doubles with each additional identity funded from the same wallet—so k fake identities cost 50·(2^k−1) tokens, making Sybil scaling exponential rather than linear. Bonds are slashed if three peers reject the agent's attestation within two epochs.
